site.name: Allard Beryllium Mine
overview: Allard Beryllium Mine is a documented historic beryllium-bearing pegmatite locality in Chaffee County's Turret Mining District, associated in mineral records with the Combination Prospect.

timeline.text: Federal pegmatite investigations documented the Combination Prospect among Chaffee County beryl-bearing pegmatites examined during wartime and postwar strategic-mineral studies.

moreHistory: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 227 lists the Combination Prospect among the beryllium pegmatites examined in Chaffee County.

Modern mapped-place records preserve the Allard Beryllium Mine name near 38.63333, -105.98390, while mineral-locality records identify the nearby Combination Prospect as the Allard Beryllium Prospect in the Turret district.
